dedupe_keys.name: japan municipal waste treatment survey ippan haikibutsu shori jittai chosa yearly results by municipality and facility including every incinerator landfill and recycling plant fy1998 to fy2024

description: This survey is Japan's yearly national survey of municipal (general) waste services. It is run by the Ministry of the Environment. Its results include a facility-level inventory of the incinerators, landfills, bulky waste plant, recycling and fuel production facility, storage site and night soil treatment plant, giving for each its municipality, name, address, annual throughput, capacity in tonnes per day, treatment method, number of furnaces, first year of use, and for incinerators the heat recovery, power generation capacity and electricity sold. Prefecture files give municipal collection systems, amounts treated, costs, staff and vehicles, and the handling of disaster waste. Results are free and available to download as Excel files for each fiscal year from FY1998 to FY2024 and are also published on e-Stat. Caveats: files use multi-row Japanese headers, facility addresses are given without coordinates, and the survey covers general (municipal) waste only, not industrial waste. Simulation uses: mapping incinerators and landfills against flood, earthquake and tsunami hazards, estimating spare treatment capacity for disaster waste after an event, using first year of use as an ageing indicator, and modelling waste flows between municipalities and shared facilities. Related records: the Japanese container and packaging recycling data (data-jcpra-japan-container-packaging-recycling-data) cover separately collected packaging, and the Italian ISPRA waste register (data-ispra-catasto-rifiuti-municipal-waste) is a comparable national source.
